meta.description: DW-4j-1, FRONTEND-BFF-CONTRACT §43.6 (reporting blueprint §10: n8n schedules, platform-nest gains no timer). Daily 06:30, after reports-nightly-facts (02:00) has rebuilt the facts: POST dept-kpis/watch. The platform evaluates every department's KPIs for the current month, compares each condition with the last one it remembered (dept_kpi_conditions), tells each department's heads ONE in-app notification per unit when something changed (dept_kpi.condition_changed), and opens or resolves the off-track alerts that feed Needs you. The decision is made once, in the platform, under a per-tenant advisory lock, so a retry (this node's retryOnFail, or the bridge redelivering a slow call) tells each change at most once: a second run in a row tells nothing. This flow does NO fan-out: it makes no hub call on success, because the platform notifies the heads itself. The endpoint is deliberately NEVER an MCP tool (it is a report_admin recompute-gated ops call, like facts/recompute), so the flow calls platform-nest DIRECTLY with the platform's own PLATFORM_SERVICE_TOKEN under the OBO identity wf:reports-kpi-watch (seed:automation grants it company_admin, the minimum role report_admin's recompute action allows). On failure: the HTTP node retries x3 (built-in retryOnFail), then the error branch raises an IN-APP notification via the hub's notify tool (the only hub call, allow-listed as [notify] in mcp-hub automation-policy.ts). Single-tenant, like every reports flow: AGENCY_TENANT_ID. Importing it on the server is a server step: a CLI import DEACTIVATES the flow, so activate it afterwards. Env: PLATFORM_URL, PLATFORM_SERVICE_TOKEN, AGENCY_TENANT_ID, HUB_SERVICE_TOKEN, NOTIFY_USER_ID.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 1, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "notify", arguments: { tenantId: $env.AGENCY_TENANT_ID, recipientId: $env.NOTIFY_USER_ID, type: "reports_kpi_watch_failed", payload: { error: $json.error } } } }) }}
